# Figure 4: High, asymmetric valency boosts multispecific selectivity beyond single-receptor targeting

::: {#fig-figure-4}

:::

* Intuition tells us that some changes in binding model optimization problems may lead to multi-receptor prioritization:
  + Different signal receptors
  +	Higher valency
  +	Asymmetric target ligand valencies
* Top hits are consistent across signal receptor definitions (generic or specific)
* Top hits are variable with changes in valency (magnitude and asymmetry)
* Increasing valency increases the utility of optimal multispecificity
* Asymmetric valency of paired targets further improves multi-receptor selectivity?
